blurb: Guests board handcrafted tiki boats with onboard restrooms and Bluetooth speakers to cruise scenic waters of Fort Myers Beach or Matlacha. Cruises are BYOB with coolers, ice, and cups provided. Tours range from 90 minutes to 6 hours and include private charters for special occasions and corporate events.
